title: MMSearch-R1: Incentivizing LMMs to Search
authors_zh: Jinming Wu, Zihao Deng, Wei Li, Yiding Liu, Bo You, Bo Li, Zejun Ma, Ziwei Liu
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: MMSearch-R1: Incentivizing LMMs to Search records multi-round text/image search traces and cached image-search results under outcome reward plus search penalty.
MMSearch-R1 以多轮图像和文本搜索训练多模态模型按需调用工具，并发布 FVQA 与缓存图像检索结果。
why: It makes RL decides multiround search actions and its audit boundary visible for reasoning-data curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: multi-round text/image search traces and cached image-search results.

title: Problem
问题
html: MMSearch-R1 asks how a multimodal model can learn whether external search is needed, which modality to search, and how to use returned web evidence, instead of applying a fixed retrieval pipeline to every question. The data challenge is to provide both search-required and search-free visual questions with concise verifiable answers, then generate multi-turn episodes that distinguish policy reasoning and search actions from externally returned image and text observations.
MMSearch-R1 研究如何让多模态模型学习“是否需要外部搜索、应搜索哪种模态、以及如何利用返回的网页证据”，而不是对每个问题固定执行检索。数据挑战是同时提供需要搜索与无需搜索的视觉问题及简洁可核验答案，并生成多轮 episode，明确区分策略产生的推理/搜索动作与环境返回的图像、文本观察。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The work combines FactualVQA (FVQA), a search-balanced training set, with a GRPO environment that exposes image and text search. Rollouts use tagged reasoning, answer, search, and information spans; retrieved content is loss-masked. Terminal feedback combines exact-match answer correctness, a penalty when a correct answer used search, and a format check. This trains selective search behavior, but it does not provide step-level correctness labels for reasoning, queries, retrieval relevance, or evidence synthesis.
该工作把搜索平衡训练集 FactualVQA（FVQA）与同时提供图像、文本搜索的 GRPO 环境结合。Rollout 使用带标签的推理、答案、搜索和信息区段，检索内容被 loss mask。终局反馈结合答案 Exact Match、正确答案使用搜索时的惩罚，以及格式检查。它用于训练选择性搜索行为，但不提供对推理、查询、检索相关性或证据综合的步骤级正确标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
FVQA-auto-vc begins with 10,000 visual concepts sampled from the head and tail of MetaCLIP metadata. For each concept, web search supplies an image and associated page; GPT-4o generates a concise factual VQA pair and classifies its knowledge type. Category balancing yields 6,000 items, split as 5,400 training and 600 test candidates. A parallel route maps InfoSeek training questions into the same taxonomy and selects 7,000 items. Human annotators add 800 questions by choosing a category, locating an image, searching for supporting information, and writing a concise answer.

Search balancing uses a Qwen2.5-VL-7B model trained on the collected pool. It generates eight rollouts per question. Questions for which all eight fail are discarded. An item is labeled image-, text-, or mixed-search-required when correct answers occur only with the corresponding search behavior; any correct no-search rollout makes it search-free. The final FVQA-train contains 5,000 items—about 3,400 search-required and 1,600 search-free. FVQA-test contains 1,800 manually verified or human-authored items: 600 held-out auto-vc, 600 InfoSeek Human Split items with newly annotated answers, and 600 manual items.

RL uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and modified GRPO. Each training step samples 512 questions with eight rollouts each; an episode allows up to three dialogue rounds and two searches, with image search allowed only in round one. Image search returns up to five thumbnail–title webpage results. Text search uses SerpApi, Jina Reader, and Qwen3-32B summaries for up to five pages. Model actions use named reason, image-search, text-search, and answer spans; returned evidence uses a named information span and is excluded from policy loss. Exact-match correctness is binary; a correct answer that used search receives a 0.1 penalty factor, and the format component has weight 0.1.

FVQA-auto-vc 从 MetaCLIP 元数据长尾头部和尾部随机抽取 1 万个视觉概念。对每个概念，网页搜索提供图像及关联页面；GPT-4o 生成简洁的事实型视觉问答并分类知识类型。按类别平衡后得到 6000 条，其中 5400 条作为训练候选、600 条作为测试候选。另一条路线把 InfoSeek 训练问题映射到同一分类体系，并选择 7000 条。人工标注者另增 800 条：选择知识类别、寻找图像、搜索支撑信息并写出简洁答案。

搜索平衡阶段使用在收集池上训练的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，每题生成 8 条 rollout；若 8 条全部失败，则因训练信号不足而丢弃。只有使用对应搜索行为时才能答对的题被标为图像、文本或混合搜索必需；只要存在无需搜索的正确 rollout，就标为 search-free。最终 FVQA-train 含 5000 条，约 3400 条 search-required、1600 条 search-free。FVQA-test 含 1800 条人工核验或人工撰写样本：600 条留出的 auto-vc、600 条重新标注答案的 InfoSeek Human Split，以及 600 条人工样本。

强化学习以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 和修改后的 GRPO 为基础。每个训练步抽取 512 个问题，每题 8 条 rollout；episode 最多三轮对话和两次搜索，图像搜索只允许在第一轮。图像搜索返回最多 5 个网页缩略图—标题结果；文本搜索通过 SerpApi、Jina Reader 和 Qwen3-32B 摘要返回最多 5 个页面。模型动作使用命名的 reason、image-search、text-search 和 answer 区段；返回证据放入命名的 information 区段，并从策略损失中排除。Exact Match 正确性为二值；答对但使用搜索时应用 0.1 的惩罚因子，格式项权重为 0.1。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The ACL paper specifies the source routes, item counts, balancing rule, episode grammar, tool stack, rollout budget, and reward components. The official FVQA endpoint currently exposes about 6.66K rows—approximately 4.86K train and 1.8K test—with an Apache-2.0 dataset tag. The official repository states that the released package includes cached image-search results, while code and a model checkpoint are also linked.

These artifacts verify the prompt dataset and cached-search release, not the release of raw GRPO episodes, rejected siblings, reward logs, or live text-search snapshots. Downstream benchmark accuracy is judged by GPT-4o and evaluates the trained policy; it is not evidence that every training answer, search classification, query, or retrieved page is correct.

ACL 论文明确披露来源路线、样本数、平衡规则、episode 语法、工具栈、rollout 预算与奖励组成。官方 FVQA 端点目前约有 6660 条记录，其中约 4860 条 train、1800 条 test，并标注 Apache-2.0。官方仓库称发布包包含缓存的图像搜索结果，同时链接代码与模型检查点。

这些工件可核实提示数据集与缓存图搜结果的发布，但不能证明原始 GRPO episode、同组被拒候选、奖励日志或实时文本搜索快照已经公开。下游 benchmark 准确率由 GPT-4o 评审，衡量的是训练后策略；不能证明每个训练答案、搜索分类、查询或返回网页都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: For reasoning-data curation, the distinctive contribution is the coupling of a search-need label with an executable multimodal episode grammar. Image identification and textual fact retrieval are separate actions, environment observations are excluded from the policy loss, and a search cost shapes when a correct-answer trajectory is preferred. The individual components—web search, GRPO, exact match, and format rewards—are established; the contribution is their integration with a released search-balanced VQA set.
对推理数据整理而言，其有辨识度的贡献是把“是否需要搜索”的标签与可执行多模态 episode 语法结合。图像识别搜索与文本事实检索是不同动作，环境观察不进入策略损失，而搜索成本会影响正确答案轨迹的偏好。网页搜索、GRPO、Exact Match 和格式奖励本身并非新技术，贡献主要在于它们与公开搜索平衡 VQA 集的整合。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Search-required labels are policy-relative: eight rollouts from one trained model do not establish an intrinsic property of a question, and discarding all-failure items removes hard cases. Exact match favors concise answers but can reject valid variants or reward unsupported guessing. The search penalty treats every search as the same cost and may suppress useful verification. Format compliance does not measure reasoning or evidence quality.

Live SerpApi results, webpages, Jina parsing, and Qwen3-32B summaries can drift or disappear. Cached image-search results improve partial replay but do not pin text-search content. Raw RL rollouts, rejected alternatives, query/retrieval relevance labels, reward logs, seeds, and complete environment snapshots are not confirmed as released. The dataset’s Apache-2.0 tag does not by itself resolve rights for every web image or page, and semantic decontamination remains unknown.

Search-required 标签相对于具体策略而定义：单个训练模型的 8 条 rollout 不能证明某道题具有内在固定的搜索需求，丢弃全部失败样本还会移除困难案例。Exact Match 便于检查简洁答案，但可能拒绝有效变体，或奖励缺少证据的猜测。搜索惩罚把每次搜索视为相同成本，可能压制有用的核验；格式合规也不衡量推理或证据质量。

实时 SerpApi 结果、网页、Jina 解析和 Qwen3-32B 摘要都会漂移或消失。缓存图像搜索结果只能改善部分回放，不能固定文本搜索内容。尚未确认发布原始 RL rollout、被拒候选、查询/检索相关性标签、奖励日志、随机种子和完整环境快照。数据集的 Apache-2.0 标签本身不能解决每张网页图像或页面的权利问题，语义去污染仍为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: MMSearch-R1 is useful both as a released prompt dataset and as a schema for multimodal search-agent trajectories. Auditable episodes should retain FVQA item/revision IDs, search-need labels and their policy dependency, every model span and action, exact query, returned URL/document IDs, thumbnails or summaries, timestamps, tool/model revisions, loss masks, terminal answer, both reward components, selected rollout, and rejected siblings. Without these fields, the method can be reproduced approximately but the original interaction corpus cannot be replayed.

MMSearch-R1 既可作为公开提示数据集，也可作为多模态搜索智能体轨迹模式参考。可审计 episode 应保留 FVQA 样本/版本 ID、搜索需求标签及其策略依赖、每段模型输出与动作、精确查询、返回 URL/文档 ID、缩略图或摘要、时间戳、工具/模型版本、loss mask、终局答案、两项奖励、选中 rollout 与同组被拒候选。缺少这些字段时，只能近似复现方法，不能回放原始交互语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate FVQA prompt records, cached image-search results, and on-policy GRPO episodes.
  • Search-required/search-free labels are induced by eight rollouts from a particular policy.
  • Retrieved information is an environment observation and is masked from policy loss.
  • Exact-match plus format reward does not verify intermediate reasoning or retrieval relevance.
  • Pin web, tool, summarizer, dataset, and code revisions; benchmark gains are not data-quality proof.

• 区分 FVQA 提示记录、缓存图像搜索结果与在线策略 GRPO episode。
  • Search-required/search-free 标签由特定策略的 8 条 rollout 推导而来。
  • 检索信息是环境观察，并从策略损失中屏蔽。
  • Exact Match 加格式奖励不验证中间推理或检索相关性。
  • 应固定网页、工具、摘要模型、数据集和代码版本；benchmark 提升不是数据质量证明。
